notes: HDFX-500-TR is a matched Tx+Rx extender kit (each unit is a compact dongle, same mechanical dimensions); modeled here with ports from both the transmitter and receiver modules. Data from Opticis official datasheet HDFX-500-TR v1.1 (May 2021), cross-checked against the current Opticis product page (opticis.com/en/product/product_view.php?prd_idx=69) and retailer listings (B&H, Markertek, Optolinks) which corroborate HDMI 2.0 support, simplex LC/OM3 fiber, and USB/DDC 5V power. Newer retailer copy (2024-2025) cites an extended 300m range and a 5-pin adapter accessory not present in the 2021 datasheet -- likely a later firmware/hardware revision; distance and accessory details noted as a caveat. HDMI grade set to hdmi-2.0 per explicit spec (18Gbps total, 6Gbps/channel, HDCP2.2, 4K60 4:4:4) -- exceeds HDMI 1.4 (10.2Gbps) but does not reach HDMI 2.1 (48Gbps), and vendor explicitly states HDMI 2.0 compliance. No AC line-power connector on the units themselves -- power comes via bundled 5V/1A wall adapters connecting through micro-USB, consistent with small dongle-style extenders. Rack units omitted (not rack-mountable; palm-sized dongle form factor).

ports.name: HDMI In (Tx)
ports.note: High-Retention HDMI receptacle on transmitter module; complies with HDMI 2.0, HDCP 2.2, CEC, EDID; max 18Gbps (6Gbps/ch), 4K 4096x2160@60Hz 4:4:4

ports.name: Optical Out (Tx)
ports.note: Simplex LC multi-mode (OM3) fiber connector on transmitter, carries HDMI signal up to 200m (656ft)

ports.name: USB Power (Tx)
ports.note: Micro-USB power input; Tx can alternatively be powered via DDC 5V from HDMI source pin 18 (Auto Power-Switching). Ships with Micro-USB-to-USB cable and 5V/1A adapter.

ports.name: Optical In (Rx)
ports.note: Simplex LC multi-mode (OM3) fiber connector on receiver

ports.name: HDMI Out (Rx)
ports.note: High-Retention HDMI receptacle on receiver module; outputs to display, HDMI 2.0/HDCP 2.2

ports.name: USB Power (Rx)
ports.note: Micro-USB power input on receiver; ships with Micro-USB-to-USB cable and 5V/1A adapter
